title: crafters+
description: This is a small modpack that makes vanilla minecraft feel more satisfying, this modpack aims to add animation to the game and just in general style.
body:
This is a modpack that uses animations to make the game look better, This modpack will not change vanilla minecraft at all, All the modpack will do is add animations and shaders to make the game look better.

Warning: This modpack may need you to manually add the resource packs and shaders!
